description: The campaign to elect Laura Ellman as State Senator has knocked over 31,000 doors with three weeks left until Election Day. This has been in large part due to the collaboration and support of allied campaigns and organizations. Organizations like Moms Demand Action and township democratic organizations and campaigns from Sadia Covert for DuPage County Board to Rep. Bill Foster …
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY ELLMAN FOR IL SENATE D21
title: All Hands On Deck: Joining Forces to Get Out the Vote - Laura Ellman
